title: Different Doses of Rosuvastatin Therapy on Regression of Critical Coronary Atherosclerosis in ACS Patients

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study is to determine whether Rosuvastatin 10mg/d or 20mg/d for 36 weeks can regress critical coronary atherosclerosis as determined by IVUS imaging in Chinese Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS) patients.
